messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "Perform a BFS traversal of the graph starting from each unvisited node.",
    "Track visited nodes and build components as we traverse the graph.",
    "Ensure components are internally sorted and the outer list is lexicographically sorted."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Edges are distinct and represent a simple undirected graph.",
    "Vertices are numbered from 0 to n-1.",
    "The graph is undirected and unweighted.",
    "Components are returned as internally sorted lists, with the outer list lexicographically sorted."
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "When the graph has a single node with no edges (connected component of size 1).",
    "When the graph has no edges (all nodes are isolated).",
    "When the graph is disconnected (multiple components)."
  ],
  "inputs": "n is an integer >= 1; edges is a list of distinct [u, v] pairs with 0 <= u < v < n.",
  "method_id": "networkx.connected_components",
  "output": "A list of sets, where each set represents a connected component of the graph.",
  "purpose": "Generate connected components of an undirected graph.",
  "signature": "solve(n, edges)"
}
